subject.title: Add a Sealos Devbox SSH-lease provider

question: Should Crabbox accept a built-in Sealos Devbox provider based on the DevBox CRD, Secret-backed SSH identity, and SSHGate/NodePort routing contract once live proof is available?
rationale: The implementation direction adds a new built-in provider, config surface, and security-sensitive credential path, so automation cannot decide the product and provider-contract boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require live proof and contract approval
options.body: Keep this issue open with the linked PR until redacted Sealos create/use/destroy proof and maintainer approval of the CRD, Secret, SSHGate/NodePort, and retained-release contract are present.

options.title: Approve a proof waiver
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly waive live proof and accept owning first real-cluster validation after merge if the provider contract is already trusted.

options.title: Pause pending Sealos contract confirmation
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open but do not merge until the supported Sealos automation surface and SSH routing semantics are confirmed upstream or by a maintainer-owned environment.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and contract approval
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with the linked PR until redacted Sealos create/use/destroy proof and maintainer approval of the CRD, Secret, SSHGate/NodePort, and retained-release contract are present.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider lifecycle and safety work plus Sealos branch hardening make this the best available routing owner for the product and safety decision.
